It does not download models or datasets, train, fine-tune, run inference, benchmark memory, publish checkpoints, call providers, provision GPU/cloud capacity, execute SSH, deploy infrastructure, or claim SEIS owns a trained 512B foundation model.

sources.label: Meta Llama 3.1 405B

sources.label: Megatron-Turing NLG 530B
sources.seisImplication: A 512B SEIS target requires distributed training architecture, model-parallel design, cost controls, observability, rollback, and independent review before any training scope.

sources.label: DeepSeek-V3 671B MoE
sources.seisImplication: Total parameters, active parameters, memory, routing, and evaluation must be tracked separately; SEIS must not equate headline parameter count with AGI capability.

sources.label: Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507
sources.seisImplication: SEIS model cards must record total parameters, activated parameters, context length, inference memory needs, license, and safety notes before any route eligibility.

sources.label: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
sources.seisImplication: 512B AGI readiness must include governance, risk mapping, measurement, management, safety, security, privacy, transparency, accountability, and fairness gates.

sources.label: Anthropic Responsible Scaling Policy
sources.seisImplication: SEIS must treat capability thresholds, deployment safeguards, security posture, and escalation reviews as promotion gates, not optional release notes.
